claims.claim: The initial run of the company's r-1 units had as of Tuesday sold out at $199 each.
Shipments are scheduled to begin in late March.
Those who preordered before January 9 can expect delivery in March, while those ordering after that official launch date should receive the item between April and May 2024.
The r1 works as a sort of universal controller for apps.
The LAM can infer and model human actions on computer interfaces by learning users' intention and behavior when they use specific apps, and then mimic and perform them both reliably and quickly.
The device features a push-to-talk button, 360-degree rotational eye and analog scroll wheel.

delta: physical handheld device with dedicated controls for voice and navigation
no screen-based app interaction, relies on natural language commands
positioned as a task automation companion rather than a phone replacement

prior_art.differs: Rabbit r1 has a small touchscreen and physical scroll wheel; AI Pin is screenless with laser projector. Rabbit is $199 with no announced subscription; AI Pin is $699 + $24/month.
